_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json; ADR-031 declarative-first (schemas + lifecycle + calculations + aggregations); ADR-022 OpenRegister approval-workflow (no app-local submission table)
_meta.description: Tier 3 — intra-community supplies (ICP) filing. Adds four new schemas that union additively onto the monolith: ViesValidation (immutable VIES verification evidence per Implementing Regulation 282/2011 Art. 18), IcpSupply (the first-class, invoice-derived supply record), IcpOpgaaf (the recapitulative statement / ICP-opgaaf with draft → finalized → submitted → accepted/rejected/corrected lifecycle), and PeriodicitySwitch (the quarterly↔monthly transition log per Art. 263 §1bis Directive 2006/112/EC). IcpOpgaaf carries an x-openregister-lifecycle (reconciliation + SBR-schema gate on finalize, approval-workflow on submit) and x-openregister-calculations for SBR/Digipoort XBRL composition. IcpSupply carries the x-openregister-aggregations shape that groups supplies by (buyerVatId, supplyType) — the ICP ledger. The engine-side fallback (prior-period opening carry, cross-schema reconciliation join, periodicity threshold) is OCA\Shillinq\Service\IcpService + IcpCalculator using the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll/saveObject). Also seeds three zero-rated RGS chart-of-accounts Account objects (8190 Omzet ICP goederen, 8195 Omzet ICP diensten, 8196 Omzet ICP driehoekstransacties) and worked ViesValidation / IcpSupply / IcpOpgaaf / PeriodicitySwitch example objects per design.md Seed Data. The pre-existing minimal IcpStatement schema (period metadata only, from add-shillinq-bookkeeping-operations) is left untouched; IcpOpgaaf is the richer line-bearing filing register the T3 spec (REQ-ICP-001..REQ-ICP-010) requires. Tasks 9-10: ARInvoice.icpContext and CustomerMaster.vatId* extension fields are now landed as deep-merge property additions on the AR-core schemas (ADR-037 — properties unioned by key, monolith untouched); ARInvoice gets the icpContext sub-object (treatAsIcp, supplyType, viesValidationId, triangulation) for REQ-ICP-001/006/007, CustomerMaster gets canonical vatId + vatIdValidatedAt + vatIdValidUntil + vatIdValidationStatus for REQ-ICP-001/009.

ViesValidation.title: VIES Validation
ViesValidation.description: Immutable record of one VIES VAT-ID verification (REQ-ICP-001, REQ-ICP-009). Captures the requestId returned by VIES as Belastingdienst audit proof (Implementing Regulation 282/2011 Art. 18), the validity result, the disclosed name/address, and an outage flag distinguishing a transient VIES outage from a definitive rejection. Validation timestamps are never updated retroactively (good-faith evidence).

vatId.description: Canonical VAT-ID validated (country code + national number, no spaces). REQ-ICP-001.
vatId.title: VAT ID

validationTimestamp.description: Moment the VIES query was made; immutable audit proof.
validationTimestamp.title: Validation Timestamp

validUntil.description: Validity horizon of this validation, typically validationTimestamp + 1 day.
validUntil.title: Valid Until

valid.description: True when VIES returned a valid VAT-ID; false is a definitive rejection (REQ-ICP-009).
valid.title: Valid

name.description: Trader name disclosed by VIES (if any).
name.title: Name

address.description: Trader address disclosed by VIES (if any).
address.title: Address

requestId.description: VIES consultation number — Belastingdienst audit proof per Implementing Regulation 282/2011 Art. 18 (REQ-ICP-001).
requestId.title: Request ID

outage.description: True when this record was created during a transient VIES outage (HTTP 5xx / SOAP MS_UNAVAILABLE) rather than a definitive answer (REQ-ICP-009).
outage.title: Outage

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-ICP-001).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a VIES Validation is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

IcpSupply.title: ICP Supply
IcpSupply.description: One intra-community supply, the first-class derived record (design.md D1). Each supply links to its source invoice line, the buyer VAT-ID, the supply type (L goods / S services / T triangulation), the amount excluding VAT (negative for credit notes, REQ-ICP-003), the time of supply (Art. 64), and the ViesValidation evidence (REQ-ICP-001, REQ-ICP-006). reportedInOpgaafId is set once the supply is rolled into a submitted IcpOpgaaf.

invoiceId.description: FK to the source invoice (string id; the Invoice schema lands with bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core).
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

invoiceLineId.description: FK to the specific invoice line this supply derives from.
invoiceLineId.title: Invoice Line ID

supplyDate.description: Time of supply per Art. 64 — determines the filing period (REQ-ICP-003).
supplyDate.title: Supply Date

buyerVatId.description: Canonical buyer VAT-ID (the C-party for triangulation, REQ-ICP-006).
buyerVatId.title: Buyer VAT ID

buyerCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the buyer VAT-ID.
buyerCountry.title: Buyer Country

supplyType.description: L = goods, S = services, T = triangulation (ABC-levering). Triangulation is reported on a separate line (REQ-ICP-006).
supplyType.title: Supply Type

amountExclVat.description: Amount excluding VAT in EUR, two decimals, half-even. Negative for credit notes (REQ-ICP-003).
amountExclVat.title: Amount Excl VAT

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency; T3 scope is EUR only.
currency.title: Currency

viesValidationId.description: FK to the ViesValidation evidence for this supply's buyer VAT-ID (REQ-ICP-001).
viesValidationId.title: Vies Validation ID

reportedInReturnId.description: FK to the IcpOpgaaf that reported this supply; null while unreported (REQ-ICP-003).
reportedInReturnId.title: Reported In Opgaaf ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-ICP-001).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

icpLedgerByBuyerSupplyType.description: The ICP ledger (REQ-ICP-003): group all qualifying IcpSupply records for a period+administration by (buyerVatId, supplyType), SUM amountExclVat with sign preserved (credit notes are negative), sort by buyerVatId ascending. Triangulation (T) lines are never merged with L or S even when the buyerVatId matches (REQ-ICP-006). When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the period-window selection, IcpService computes the same result in PHP via the real ObjectService API.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a ICP Supply is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

IcpOpgaaf.title: ICP-opgaaf (Recapitulative Statement)
IcpOpgaaf.description: An intra-community supplies recapitulative statement (REQ-ICP-003..REQ-ICP-010). Aggregates qualifying IcpSupply records by (buyerVatId, supplyType) into lines, carries the period totals (goods/services/triangulation), the SBR/Digipoort XBRL payload archived for the 10-year bewaarplicht, and the Belastingdienst kenmerk. Corrections are separate filings of type=correction referencing correctsPeriod (REQ-ICP-008). The richer, line-bearing companion of the pre-existing minimal IcpStatement schema.

status.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-ICP-004, REQ-ICP-005). draft → finalized → submitted → accepted/rejected/corrected.
status.title: Status

type.description: initial filing or a correction filing (REQ-ICP-008).
type.title: Type

correctsPeriod.description: For type=correction, the original period being corrected (REQ-ICP-008).
correctsPeriod.title: Corrects Period

lines.description: Aggregated lines, one per (buyerVatId, supplyType), sorted by buyerVatId (REQ-ICP-003).

buyerVatId.title: Buyer VAT ID
buyerVatId.description: The date and time for buyer vat id.

supplyType.title: Supply Type
supplyType.description: The type or category of suppl.

amountExclVat.title: Amount Excl VAT
amountExclVat.description: The amount excl vat as a numeric value.

lines.title: Lines

total.description: Sum of all line amounts in EUR (REQ-ICP-004 reconciliation target).
total.title: Total

totalGoods.description: Sum of L + T lines (goods, including triangulation, REQ-ICP-002 threshold base).
totalGoods.title: Total Goods

totalTriangulation.description: Sum of T lines only, for reporting clarity (REQ-ICP-006).
totalTriangulation.title: Total Triangulation

taxAuthorityReference.description: Reference number from the Digipoort submission confirmation (REQ-ICP-010).
taxAuthorityReference.title: Belastingdienst Kenmerk

submittedAt.description: Moment the filing was submitted to Digipoort.
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

xmlPayload.description: Archived SBR/Digipoort XBRL instance (NT18, bd-rpt-icp-2026.xsd) for the 10-year bewaarplicht (REQ-ICP-005).
xmlPayload.title: XML Payload

auditBundle.description: FK to the audit-trail inspection bundle file (REQ-ICP-010).
auditBundle.title: Audit Bundle

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-ICP-004).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.description: System-generated aggregation, editable by the bookkeeper.

finalize.description: Reconciliation gate against BTW-aangifte rubriek 3b within EUR 1 tolerance (REQ-ICP-004) and SBR/NT18 schema validation (REQ-ICP-005).

finalized.description: Locked; reconciliation and SBR schema validated.

submit.description: Approval routing consumed from OpenRegister (ADR-022); then deliver via the existing Digipoort channel.

submitted.description: Delivered to Digipoort; awaiting Belastingdienst processing.

accepted.description: Belastingdienst confirmed receipt and validation pass.

rejected.description: Belastingdienst validation failure; bookkeeper corrects and refiles.

corrected.description: Superseded by a correction filing referencing this period (REQ-ICP-008).

xmlPayload.description: SBR/Digipoort XBRL composition (REQ-ICP-005). Pure data → XML transformation conforming to bd-rpt-icp-2026.xsd (NT18): one bd-i:IntracommunautairePrestatieMutatieSpecificatie per line, gl-cor:periodIdentifier from period, supplyCode L/S/T, amounts EUR two-decimal half-even. Composed declaratively from lines; IcpCalculator::composeXbrl is the engine-side fallback when the calculation engine cannot emit XBRL, and validates the instance before finalize.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a ICP-opgaaf (Recapitulative Statement) is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PeriodicitySwitch.title: Periodicity Switch
PeriodicitySwitch.description: Log of one quarterly↔monthly filing-periodicity transition (REQ-ICP-002). Created when cumulative goods supplies (L + T) breach EUR 50,000 in a calendar quarter, effective the first day of the following month per Art. 263 §1bis Directive 2006/112/EC and Art. 32 Uitvoeringsregeling OB. Switch-back to quarterly is offered only at a year boundary after four quarters below threshold.

triggerDate.description: Date the EUR 50,000 threshold was breached.
triggerDate.title: Trigger Date

triggerAmount.description: Cumulative goods-supply amount that triggered the switch.
triggerAmount.title: Trigger Amount

triggerQuarter.description: The calendar quarter in which the breach occurred (YYYY-Qn).
triggerQuarter.title: Trigger Quarter

effectiveDate.description: First day of the period the new periodicity takes effect (REQ-ICP-002).
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of this record.

reversedAt.description: Moment the switch was reverted at a year boundary (REQ-ICP-002).
reversedAt.title: Reversed At

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Periodicity Switch is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

icpContext.description: Intra-community supplies overlay populated when the invoice is treated as ICP (REQ-ICP-001, REQ-ICP-006, REQ-ICP-007). Set by the VIES validation flow when the customer is in another EU member state with a valid VAT-ID. Drives ICP ledger aggregation, reverse-charge PDF rendering (REQ-ICP-007), and the Belastingdienst rubriek 3b reconciliation gate (REQ-ICP-004). Triangulation supplies (Article 141 VAT Directive 2006/112/EC) carry supplyType T and report the C-party VAT-ID rather than the A-party's.

treatAsIcp.description: True when the invoice MUST be reported on the ICP-opgaaf (intra-community supply, zero-rated, reverse-charged). Drives REQ-ICP-003 aggregation and REQ-ICP-007 PDF rendering.
treatAsIcp.title: Treat As ICP

supplyType.description: ICP supply-type code per Belastingdienst NT18 taxonomy: L = goods (Leveringen), S = services (diensten), T = triangulation (driehoekstransactie / ABC-levering per Article 141 VAT Directive). Routes to chart-of-accounts 8190 / 8195 / 8196.
supplyType.title: Supply Type

viesValidationId.description: FK to the ViesValidation record proving the buyer VAT-ID was VIES-verified at invoice time (good-faith defence per Implementing Regulation 282/2011 Article 18).
viesValidationId.title: Vies Validation ID

triangulation.description: True when this invoice is a triangulation supply (REQ-ICP-006). When true the system validates and reports the C-party VAT-ID against VIES, never the A-party's.
triangulation.title: Triangulation

icpContext.title: ICP Context

vatId.description: EU VAT-ID in canonical form (country code + national number, e.g. BE0123456789, FR12345678901) used for VIES verification on B2B intra-community supplies per REQ-ICP-001. Decoupled from the legacy btwNumber free-form field; canonical form is REQUIRED for VIES round-trips. When set and the buyer country differs from the seller's, invoices for this customer become ICP candidates.
vatId.title: VAT ID

vatIdValidatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent definitive VIES verification of vatId. Last-known-good evidence for the REQ-ICP-009 outage fallback (recent valid record within 30 days survives a transient VIES outage).
vatIdValidatedAt.title: VAT ID Validated At

vatIdValidUntil.description: Cache-expiry hint for the recorded VIES verification (typically vatIdValidatedAt + 1 day). After this timestamp the system MUST revalidate on next ICP-triggering save.
vatIdValidUntil.title: VAT ID Valid Until

vatIdValidationStatus.description: Most recent VIES verification outcome (REQ-ICP-001 + REQ-ICP-009). unchecked = no VIES query yet; valid = VIES returned valid:true; invalid = VIES returned valid:false (block ICP overlay); vies_outage = transient VIES outage; the system attaches the recent valid ViesValidation and queues daily revalidation via ViesOutageRetryJob.
vatIdValidationStatus.title: VAT ID Validation Status

objects.name: Omzet ICP goederen
objects.description: Zero-rated intra-community goods supplies (supplyType L). RGS pattern. Routed from IcpSupply supplyType L.

objects.name: Omzet ICP diensten
objects.description: Zero-rated intra-community services supplies (supplyType S). RGS pattern. Routed from IcpSupply supplyType S.

objects.name: Omzet ICP driehoekstransacties
objects.description: Zero-rated triangulation supplies (supplyType T, ABC-levering). RGS pattern. Routed from IcpSupply supplyType T.
